mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat.dim_district (code, name_en, name_ar, sort_no, makani_district_id, makani_name, centroid, bbox, boundary, scope, updated_at) VALUES (#{d.code}, #{d.nameEn}, #{d.nameAr}, #{d.sortNo}, #{d.makaniDistrictId}, #{d.makaniName}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{d.centroidLon}, #{d.centroidLat}), 4326), ST_MakeEnvelope(#{d.minLon}, #{d.minLat}, #{d.maxLon}, #{d.maxLat}, 4326), ST_Multi(ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{d.boundaryEwkbHex}, 'hex'))), ST_Multi(ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{d.scopeEwkbHex}, 'hex'))), now())

INSERT INTO stat.stat_district_makani (district_code, area_km2, communities, plots, plots_constructed, plots_under_construction, plots_vacant_serviced, plots_vacant_unserviced, buildings, buildings_under_construction, schools, medical, mosques, source_as_of, extracted_at) VALUES
(#{d.code}, #{d.areaKm2}, #{d.communities}, #{d.plots}, #{d.plotsConstructed}, #{d.plotsUnderConstruction}, #{d.plotsVacantServiced}, #{d.plotsVacantUnserviced}, #{d.buildings}, #{d.buildingsUnderConstruction}, #{d.schools}, #{d.medical}, #{d.mosques}, #{asOf}, now())
INSERT INTO stat.stat_district_landuse (district_code, use_desc, plot_count) VALUES (#{r.code}, #{r.useDesc}, #{r.plotCount})

INSERT INTO stat.stat_district_liveability (district_code, score_existing, score_current, score_target, parks, park_area_ha, park_gap_ha, is_sample, source_as_of, extracted_at) VALUES
(#{d.code}, #{d.scoreExisting}, #{d.scoreCurrent}, #{d.scoreTarget}, #{d.parks}, #{d.parkAreaHa}, #{d.parkGapHa}, false, #{asOf}, now())
